answers.brief_reasoning: Loop over characters, count those between 'A' and 'Z'.
answers.final_answer: public static int countUpper(String s) { int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) { String c = s.substring(i, i + 1); if (c.compareTo("A") >= 0 && c.compareTo("Z") <= 0) count++; } return count; }

answers.brief_reasoning: Compute length and upper count; check strong, then medium, else weak.
answers.final_answer: public static String rate(String s) { int up = countUpper(s); boolean longPw = s.length() >= 6; if (longPw && up >= 2) return "strong"; if (longPw || up >= 1) return "medium"; return "weak"; }
